meanings: to destroy/perish, take someone unexpectedly or unaware; death or decree of death; cast away, cause to fall; a place which roads or ways are unapparent so it causes people to go astray; hastening; become altered in state or appearance; dubious, confused; far extent, extremities; distress, trouble, molestation; unfaithfulness; a kind of jinn or demon that destroys men; bad or corrupt conduct, evil, mischief

occurrences.verseArabic: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنْزَفُونَ
occurrences.verseTransliteration: Lâ fîhâ gavlun ve lâ hum anhâ yunzefûn(yunzefûne).
occurrences.verseMeaning: Sersemletme/başağrısı yok onda. Sarhoş da olmazlar ondan.
